Goal `core-uri-2-2`: 9 of the goal's 11 `Core\Uri` members have their feature proofs. `with` and
`withQueryParameter` landed this session, with plain help cards in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs`.
`toString` and `tryParse` are left. Both already have their tests: a `covers:` marker on
`a_parsed_uri_round_trips_through_its_own_text` and two `.nvst` cases for `toString`, and the new Rust
test `try_parse_answers_null_exactly_where_parse_throws` for `tryParse`. Each still owes about,
3 examples, a hostile and a bench, plus its card in the plain voice. Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Uri::toString`** — owes about, examples, hostile and perf (`bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Uri::toString' --show`). It returns the parsed text byte for byte, and `echo $uri` prints the same text. `HTTP://Example.COM/a%2fb` comes back unchanged. Rewrite `TO_STRING_DOC` in the plain voice. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs:911`

**`Core\Uri::tryParse`** — owes about, examples, hostile and perf. It returns `null` wherever `parse` throws: a space, a bad `%`, a port past `65535`. A relative text such as `/relative?x=1` is a `Uri` whose `scheme()` is `null`. Rewrite `TRY_PARSE_DOC` in the plain voice, and drop its `filter_var` history. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs:699`

**Reach the goal** — when `bun nv proofs --verify --only` over the goal's 11 members prints `nothing owed`, run `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes core-uri-2-2` and `bun nv playbook --closes core-uri-2-2`, then write `DONE`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs:699`

backlog: None of the two remaining members has a known bug. The probe of `with`, `withQueryParameter`, `toString` and `tryParse` matched every card (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs`).
